top_signals.title: Oil Prices Lower as Focus Shifts to Middle East Supply

top_signals.title: Baytex Energy, Saturn Oil on Fueling Canada’s Energy Growth
top_signals.summary: Chad Lundberg, CEO, Baytex Energy and Scott Sanborn, Chief Financial Officer, Saturn Oil & Gas, discuss capital allocation, production growth, consolidation and access to global markets as Canada’s oil and gas producers navigate changing commodity markets, with Bloomberg’s Monique Mulima at the 2026 Bloomberg Canadian Finance Conference.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Former US Air Force members sent to prison over BEC attacks
top_signals.summary: Two former members of the United States Air Force were sentenced to a combined 189 months in federal prison for their roles in a multi-year series of business email compromise (BEC) scams and phishing campaigns. [...]

top_signals.title: Tenaz Energy on International Growth
top_signals.summary: Tenaz Energy CEO Tony Marino discusses the company’s international growth and acquisition strategy and how it is navigating commodity-price volatility, capital allocation and geopolitical and regulatory risk as it expands its portfolio, with Bloomberg’s Monique Mulima at the 2026 Bloomberg Canadian Finance Conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
